description: SQL-backed GPS, battery and recorded state. Historical F09 replay is distinct from a live device.

options.content: **Recorded source, not a live aircraft.** GPS, battery and recorded autopilot state come from ClickHouse; the screen refreshes every five seconds. Native-time limit **0 = latest admitted observation**; enter boot microseconds to inspect an earlier point. Refresh does not start replay. GPS UTC is not proven physical sample time. Unknown associations stay empty; the map's last recorded marker does not establish a current connection. Charts show the latest ten native-clock minutes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT vehicle_id, latitude_deg AS latitude, longitude_deg AS longitude FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id = ${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring}) = 0 OR native_timestamp_us <= toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings)) AS o INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT recording_id,vehicle_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings) AS r USING(recording_id) WHERE latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY observation_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1 SETTINGS max_execution_time=10, max_threads=1, max_memory_usage=268435456, max_rows_to_read=50000, max_bytes_to_read=64000000, read_overflow_mode='throw'

SELECT latitude_deg AS latitude, longitude_deg AS longitude FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id = ${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring}) = 0 OR native_timestamp_us <= toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings)) WHERE observation_ordinal % 50=0 AND latitude_deg IS NOT NULL AND longitude_deg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY observation_ordinal SETTINGS max_execution_time=10, max_threads=1, max_memory_usage=268435456, max_rows_to_read=50000, max_bytes_to_read=64000000, read_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.description: ClickHouse coordinates only. Every 50th historical observation is drawn; no external map tiles are requested. A retained marker is not a live-position claim.

panels.title: Values, association status and age at cursor

targets.rawSql: WITH snapshot AS (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id = ${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring}) = 0 OR native_timestamp_us <= toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings) ORDER BY observation_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT observation_ordinal AS ordinal, native_timestamp_us AS boot_us, tupleElement(reading,2) AS field, tupleElement(reading,3) AS value, tupleElement(reading,4) AS unit, tupleElement(reading,5) AS association_status, if(isNull(tupleElement(reading,3)), 'missing', 'available') AS value_status, tupleElement(reading,6) AS age_seconds FROM snapshot ARRAY JOIN [tuple(0, 'latitude_deg', latitude_deg, 'deg', gps_status, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64))), tuple(1, 'longitude_deg', longitude_deg, 'deg', gps_status, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64))), tuple(2, 'altitude_msl_m', altitude_msl_m, 'm', gps_status, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64))), tuple(3, 'ground_speed_m_s', ground_speed_m_s, 'm/s', gps_status, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64))), tuple(4, 'fix_type', fix_type, 'code', gps_status, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64))), tuple(5, 'voltage_v', voltage_v, 'V', battery_status, battery_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(6, 'current_a', current_a, 'A', battery_status, battery_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(7, 'remaining_fraction', remaining_fraction, 'fraction', battery_status, battery_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(8, 'landed', landed, 'flag', land_status, land_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(9, 'ground_contact', ground_contact, 'flag', land_status, land_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(10, 'maybe_landed', maybe_landed, 'flag', land_status, land_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(11, 'arming_state', arming_state, 'code', commander_status, commander_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(12, 'nav_state', nav_state, 'code', commander_status, commander_age_us/1000000.0), tuple(13, 'failsafe', failsafe, 'flag', commander_status, commander_age_us/1000000.0)] AS reading ORDER BY tupleElement(reading,1) SETTINGS max_execution_time=10, max_threads=1, max_memory_usage=268435456, max_rows_to_read=50000, max_bytes_to_read=64000000, read_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: GPS ground speed (m/s)
panels.description: Latest ten native-clock minutes at the selected cursor. Points preserve gaps; missing values remain NULL. Boot time is not UTC. Association status and age appear separately; recorded state codes are not flight-phase classifications.

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT max(native_timestamp_us) FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id=${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})=0 OR native_timestamp_us<=toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings)) AS end_us SELECT DISTINCT toFloat64(native_timestamp_us)/1000000 AS native_boot_seconds,ground_speed_m_s FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id=${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})=0 OR native_timestamp_us<=toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings) AND toInt64(native_timestamp_us)>=toInt64(end_us)-600000000 ORDER BY native_boot_seconds SETTINGS max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw'

panels.title: Association ages (s)
panels.description: Latest ten native-clock minutes at the selected cursor. Points preserve gaps; missing values remain NULL. Boot time is not UTC. Association status and age appear separately; recorded state codes are not flight-phase classifications.

targets.rawSql: WITH (SELECT max(native_timestamp_us) FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id=${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})=0 OR native_timestamp_us<=toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings)) AS end_us SELECT DISTINCT toFloat64(native_timestamp_us)/1000000 AS native_boot_seconds,battery_age_us/1000000.0 AS battery_age_s,land_age_us/1000000.0 AS land_age_s,commander_age_us/1000000.0 AS commander_age_s FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id=${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})=0 OR native_timestamp_us<=toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings) AND toInt64(native_timestamp_us)>=toInt64(end_us)-600000000 ORDER BY native_boot_seconds SETTINGS max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw'

SELECT battery_status,land_status,commander_status,uniqExact(observation_id) AS observations FROM recording_views_v1.observations WHERE recording_id=${recording:sqlstring} AND (toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})=0 OR native_timestamp_us<=toUInt64OrNull(${native_us:sqlstring})) AND recording_id IN (SELECT recording_id FROM recording_views_v1.recordings) GROUP BY battery_status,land_status,commander_status ORDER BY battery_status,land_status,commander_status SETTINGS max_execution_time=10,max_threads=1,max_memory_usage=268435456,max_rows_to_read=50000,max_bytes_to_read=64000000,read_overflow_mode='throw'

SELECT vehicle_id AS recording_vehicle, records AS observed_rows, first_native_us/1000000.0 AS first_boot_seconds, last_native_us/1000000.0 AS last_boot_seconds, JSONExtractString(capabilities_json,'gps') AS GPS, JSONExtractString(capabilities_json,'battery') AS battery, JSONExtractString(capabilities_json,'state') AS recorded_state FROM (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM recording_views_v1.recordings WHERE recording_id=${recording:sqlstring}) SETTINGS max_execution_time=10, max_threads=1, max_memory_usage=268435456, max_rows_to_read=50000, max_bytes_to_read=64000000, read_overflow_mode='throw'
